title: Andy Kirk's stranded band; Mary Lou Williams and Ben Thigpen
summary: When the Cotton Club job ended he made friends with Andy Kirk's stranded band and rode with Mary Lou Williams towards Kansas City.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Yeah.
And --
Yeah, you learned, because that is the test for a drummer, isn't it?

I could say I was really a very good show drummer. And when I left the Cotton Club, well Andy Kirk's band came to Cincinnati and they were stranded there, with Fay Terrell, and we became very good friends, Fay Terrell and I.
Oh, did you?
And Mary Lou Williams.
Yeah.
